claims: The 2026 Masters has a $22.5 million purse.
Rory McIlroy is the winner of the 2026 Masters.
Rory McIlroy earned $4.5 million as the winner of the 2026 Masters.
$4.5 million is the largest winner's share in the Masters tournament's history.
Scottie Scheffler is the runner-up of the 2026 Masters.
Scottie Scheffler earned $2.43 million as runner-up in the 2026 Masters.
All players making the cut in the 2026 Masters received a share of the prize pool.
Tyrrell Hatton, Russell Henley, Justin Rose, and Cameron Young each earned $1.08 million for T-3rd in the 2026 Masters.
Collin Morikawa and Sam Burns each earned $725,625 for T-7th in the 2026 Masters.
Max Homa and Xander Schauffele each earned $630,000 for T-9th in the 2026 Masters.
Players who missed the cut in the 2026 Masters received $25,000 each.
54 players made the cut in the 2026 Masters.
Payouts decrease for lower positions among players who made the cut in the 2026 Masters.
